title: GPU cloud Northwind Compute slashes H-class pricing 22%
author: InfraWeekly newsdesk
text:
Northwind Compute is cutting on-demand pricing for its H-class GPU instances by 22%, taking the list rate to $2.15 per GPU-hour from November 1, the GPU cloud provider said Friday.

The reduction applies across all of Northwind's regions and covers single-node and cluster reservations of up to 512 accelerators. Committed-use contracts signed within the past 90 days will be repriced automatically.

"Capacity that was scarce a year ago is now available, and we want customers building on Northwind rather than waiting in someone else's queue," co-founder Marcus Hale said.

It is the deepest list-price reduction by a major GPU cloud this year, and it arrives as new chip supply reaches data centres. Northwind operates about 85,000 accelerators in nine data centres.
